# The Crawl Price Index

> A living observatory measuring what the web charges AI systems to read it: observed pay-per-crawl prices, AI-bot block rates across the Tranco top-N, and the taxonomy of paywall signals. Updated weekly.

## What we measure
- Observed pay-per-crawl prices returned in crawler-facing HTTP 402 responses (e.g. Cloudflare pay-per-crawl `crawler-price` quotes, x402 settlement format).
- AI-crawler block rates in robots.txt across the Tranco top-N, per bot (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, CCBot, Google-Extended, PerplexityBot, OAI-SearchBot and more).
- Marketplace and paywall fingerprints: TollBit token walls, licensing-contact 402s, declared-free headers.
- Per-country and per-language editions (subscriber tier).

## Key data
- Machine-readable feed: /index.json
- Methodology: /methodology.html

## Access
- Headline figures are free to cite with attribution.
- Full per-domain dataset, weekly history, publisher panel and country editions: subscription (Terminal tier).
- This site's data is also available to AI agents via pay-per-crawl.

## Citation
Cite as: "The Crawl Price Index (crawlpriceindex), [scan date]."
